title: Tool catalog
description: The catalog of tools a business needs, at packages/naive/src/functions/tools.json (venture console spec, 2026-11-24, phase 3). It is a three-level taxonomy: function (APQC level 1, an id in packages/naive/src/functions/departments.json), process group (APQC level 2), tool. Each tool names the record types it reads and writes, so a console can build its navigation and each screen from Naive data instead of a hand-kept list. A tool whose function is null is universal: every business gets it. It names no vendor: every object allows only the properties listed. packages/naive/src/checks/check-tools.ts checks it across files.

kinds.description: What a tool does with records, one meaning each.

process_groups.description: APQC Process Classification Framework level 2 groups (cross-industry, version 7.4 names), each under the function whose APQC id is its prefix.

id.description: The APQC hierarchy id, such as 3.5.

function.description: An id in packages/naive/src/functions/departments.json whose apqc.id is this group's prefix.

pcf.description: APQC's element id for the group, where the research recorded it.

function.description: The function the tool serves, or null for a universal tool.

title.description: The label a person sees, in plain words.

phase.description: The earliest phase in which most businesses need the tool.

about.description: One sentence on what the tool is for.

process_groups.description: The process groups the tool serves, all under its function; empty for a universal tool.

reads.description: Record types in the data model the tool reads; * is every type.

writes.description: Record types in the data model the tool writes; * is every type.

proposes.description: Record types the tool needs that the data model does not have yet. A tool that reads, writes and keeps nothing else is proposed, not built.

paths.description: Logical venture paths the tool keeps that are not records, such as files.

cluster.description: The capability cluster (packages/naive/src/functions/it/capability-clusters.json) whose outside tool it usually needs.
